subject: Scheduled withdrawal windows, invoice ledger responsibilities and VAT handoff
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@brightlane.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: payments@brightlane.io
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 12:12:00 -0500
Subject: Brightlane annual prepay drawdown cadence (PO attached)

Hi Sofia / Priyom,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We agreed internally to move forward with the annual prepay (Committed Spend) for calendar 2027. Procurement asked me to capture the specific withdrawal cadence so their finance team can map against our bank sweep windows and VAT reporting.

Key asks from Brightlane:
- A fixed calendar of withdrawal windows (monthly or quarterly) with earliest cutoffs for invoices and ledger postings.
- Confirmation of which Redwood entity will issue the invoices (US v. EU) so we can align VAT handling.
- A sample invoice / ledger layout so our AP team can auto-match against the PO.

Attached: BRIGHTLANE_PO_8743.pdf (PO), please also share a Redwood invoice template we can use.

Can you confirm the recommended cadence (we prefer monthly on the 1st or 15th) and whether Redwood can provide VAT evidence for any country-level reclaim?

Best,
Elena
Head of Finance, Brightlane

Attachments: BRIGHTLANE_PO_8743.pdf (pdf, 220KB)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@brightlane.io>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 12:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Brightlane annual prepay drawdown cadence (PO attached)

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Looping Priyom (collection ops) and Hannah (tax/VAT lead) to confirm the operational pieces. Quick answers from our side:

- Withdrawals: we support monthly withdrawals by default. Typical pattern we recommend (and can configure): scheduled sweep on the 1st of each month with a 3-business-day invoice cut window (invoices generated on the 1st, payments collected between 2nd-4th). We can also do a mid-month (15th) sweep if that aligns better with your cash planning.

- Invoicing entity: Redwood will issue invoices out of Redwood, Inc. (US entity) for this agreement by default. For EU-resident customers we offer an EU billing entity option; that requires prior notice so VAT routing and country-specific evidence can be attached.

- Invoice template: attaching our standard "redwood_invoice_template.xlsx" — it includes the ledger reference, PO field, and the line-level token breakdown your AP team can use for auto-matching.

Hannah — can you confirm what VAT evidence we can provide routinely (e.g., VAT registration copy, zero-rating statements, monthly statements) and whether Brightlane needs signed attestations?

Sofia
Director, Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_invoice_template.xlsx (xlsx, 45KB)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@brightlane.io>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, procurement@shopline.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Brightlane annual prepay drawdown cadence (PO attached)

Hi all — quick VAT note from tax:

1) For the US-billed option (Redwood, Inc.) Brightlane will not see VAT on Redwood invoices; VAT considerations fall to Brightlane's local reclaim processes if they are VAT-registered in their jurisdictions.

2) If Brightlane elects EU billing, we can issue invoices from Redwood Europe GmbH. In that case we will:
   - attach country-specific VAT registration numbers on every invoice,
   - include a monthly VAT evidence pack (CSV + PDF attestation) at month-end, and
   - provide signed letters on request for procurement/audit.

3) Evidence we can routinely provide: VAT_Evidence_guide.pdf (attached) — contains list of artifacts, typical turnaround (3 business days), and contact points. For any special country (e.g., Brazil, India) we will need lead time to collect local tax certificates.

If Brightlane confirms monthly sweep on the 1st, Priyom's team will publish an invoice-ledger mapping sheet that shows the exact ledger id and invoice numbering convention to include in the PO.

-Hannah
Tax Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: VAT_Evidence_guide.pdf (pdf, 140KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@brightlane.io>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Brightlane annual prepay drawdown cadence (PO attached)

Thanks Elena — confirming next steps and responsibilities so procurement and AP have a single point of truth: 

1) Cadence: monthly sweep on the 1st (invoice file generated 00:00 UTC on the 1st; cut-off for edits is previous business day 16:00 UTC).
2) Invoice owner: Redwood, Inc. will issue invoices unless Brightlane requests EU billing by Dec 01 (we need that in writing).
3) Ledger mapping: see attached template (redwood_invoice_template.xlsx) — please map PO field to the "external_po" column so our AP auto-match succeeds.
4) VAT evidence: Hannah will deliver the month-end pack by the 5th of each month if EU billing is enabled; for US billing, we will provide VAT guidance and registration copies on request.
5) Deliverables & timeline:
   - Priyom to publish the final sweep calendar and ledger IDs by Mon, Nov 16.
   - Contract/legal to confirm whether PO number on file (BRIGHTLANE_PO_8743) is final.
   - Elena / Brightlane to confirm EU billing election no later than Dec 01 if they wish to change entity.

If that all sounds good I will also kick off the HubSpot deal update (DL-8743) and send a DocuSign for the amendment to the billing entity (if required).

Thanks — Priyom
Sr. Manager, Collection Ops | Redwood Inference
